race.comment: Very tough race to assess with a field of debutants engaged. TOTATSU (5) looks the pick of them after an impressive Doomben trial win. The low draw will give him a great look and he appears the one to beat. ROWDY RETURN (4) is a Pierro colt on debut for the Birchley team. Has come along nicely in his two Sunny Coast trials and is drawn to get all the favours on the inside. Will pay to watch for any market moves. STEPH'S READY (8) and MISHANI FLYER (3) looks best of the rest of the debutants.
